name: magic-ui-globe
blurb: 3D rotating globe responds to pointer movement with geographic markers.
description: A WebGL-rendered 3D globe using the cobe library with pointer-driven rotation via spring physics. Displays geographic markers and supports customization via COBEOptions configuration.
use_when: Landing pages, analytics dashboards, or global company pages showcasing geographic reach.
avoid_when: Low-end devices without WebGL; pointer interaction unavailable on touch-only surfaces.
a11y: Canvas with no native accessibility features; pointer movement only; no touch or keyboard support.
